content: Mongoose 7.22 (Jun 2026) is a two-file library (mongoose.c + mongoose.h). For Pico W, the recommended approach is NOT FetchContent but direct file copy into the project. mongoose_config.h needs: #define MG_ARCH MG_ARCH_PICOSDK and #define MG_ENABLE_LWIP 1. Alternatively use Mongoose's own TCP/IP stack (MG_ENABLE_TCPIP=1) with CYW43 driver callbacks (4 functions: send, receive, up, init). Event loop: mg_mgr_init(&mgr, NULL), mg_ws_connect(&mgr, url, fn, arg, hdrs) then while(1){ mg_mgr_poll(&mgr, ms); cyw43_poll(); }. Events: MG_EV_WS_OPEN (connection ready), MG_EV_WS_MSG (struct mg_ws_message* with data mg_str). target_link_libraries needs pico_cyw43_arch_lwip_threadsafe_background (for lwIP mode) or pico_cyw43_arch_none (for standalone Mongoose TCP/IP). Git: https://github.com/cesanta/mongoose, tag 7.22.
